title: Ollama lane: a tool call leaked as a Python-literal dict (None/True/False) is not rescued; the raw call blob is shown as the assistant reply
repro: llama3.1:8b on own sidecar :52825, prompt 'Buy 10 RELIANCE for me' (ask or auto): 3-4 of 6 G8-2 replies were the literal text {"name": "portfolio_add_position", "parameters": {... "cost_basis": None ...}}. rescue_leaked_tool_call returns None for that verbatim text (json.loads fails on None) and rescues the identical text with null (G8-2/rescue-repro.txt). Class gap of R15-AGENT-018 (fixed): JSON and call-syntax are handled, the Python-literal dict form is not. Safety held: nothing staged or applied.

title: A bare-ticker portfolio lot is re-priced against a different listing when the session region changes: INFY 20 @ Rs1,500 shows -$29,779.20 (-99.26%) under region US
repro: Holding INFY qty 20 cost 1500 (bare symbol, as the add form and portfolio_add_position store it; entered under region IN where /quotes/INFY = INR 1035, P&L -Rs9,300 correct). Switch region to US: PortfolioPanel fetches /quotes/INFY with X-Vysted-Region US -> the NYSE ADR, USD 11.04; the row reads Avg cost $1,500.00, P&L -$29,779.20 (-99.26%), the header Total P&L -$28,242.30 (-88.81%), and the CSV export carries the same figures with Currency USD. Holding stores no listing or currency, so nothing detects the cost/price currency mismatch. Class sibling of R15-DATA-002 (blocked_tier4, DECISIONS 4.15): that entry's scope and its pending option (a) cover the watchlist pick and the agent add_to_watchlist leg only; the portfolio Holding (and portfolio_add_position) carry no region either, and here the harm is a fabricated money P&L, so it is filed as its own site rather than attached.

title: Screener freshness line prints unrounded float seconds ('quotes 41.64699196815491s ago')
repro: Run any screen (custom INFY.NS,TCS.NS,...; region IN) in ScreenerPanel; within the first minute the freshness line reads 'quotes 41.64699196815491s ago · valuation 41.64699912071228s ago · deep fields 46.1444091796875s ago'. fmtAgo computes Math.floor(Date.now()/1000) - epochSec with a float epochSec from the sidecar freshness block and prints it as is below 60 s.

title: News titles keep raw HTML entities: the News Feed shows 'F&O Talk: ...' literally
repro: GET /news?limit=60 (region IN): Economic Times items arrive as 'F&O Talk: 22,600 is a key Nifty support; ...' and 'Bonus issues & stock split: ...'. NewsFeedPanel renders item.title as text, so the panel shows '&'. Same text reaches the agent news tool.

title: A corrupt custom_agents.db 500s every custom-agent route (list, get, create) for good: no quarantine or recovery, unlike workspaces
repro: Own bundle sidecar :52827, data $S/ls2-data: create a custom agent (201), stop, truncate custom_agents.db 12288->6144 bytes, reboot. GET /custom-agents, GET /custom-agents/custom:ls2-agent and POST /custom-agents all return 500 (sqlite3.DatabaseError: database disk image is malformed, boot-3.log); the user cannot even create a new agent until the file is removed by hand, and a 500 without CORS headers shows in the webview as a CORS error. In the same boot the half-written workspace blob was quarantined as .corrupt-<ts> and served 404 (R15-DATA-090's fix), and an 18-byte garbage delegate_runs.db was silently re-initialised by SQLite. Class sibling of R15-DATA-090 (fixed, workspace JSON only): agents_store._connect has no DatabaseError handling.

title: A bundle sidecar that cannot bind its port dies with SIGABRT (exit 134, 'Fatal Python error: _enter_buffered_busy' on the stdin watchdog) instead of a clean non-zero exit
repro: With my own sidecar holding :52825, start the bundle binary on --port 52825 with stdin held open (fifo): uvicorn logs [Errno 48] address already in use, shuts down, then the interpreter aborts at finalisation because the stdin-EOF watchdog daemon thread holds the stdin buffer lock (taken-port.log); exit status 134. The first instance is unaffected (health 200). On macOS an abort also writes a crash report.

title: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists the wrong version for 56 of 121 main-sidecar Python components: transitive deps are unpinned, so the bundle ships what pip resolved at build time
repro: final-cand d38b5d1a: compare THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 'Python - vysted-sidecar' rows with the build venv final-cand/sidecar/.venv (built 14:35, the venv the bundle binary was frozen from): 56 of 121 differ (anyio 4.13.0 listed vs 4.15.1, aiohttp 3.13.5 vs 3.14.3, cachetools 6.2.6 vs 7.2.0, caio 0.9.25 vs 0.12.9, certifi 2026.5.20 vs 2026.7.22, ...; LS-4/notices-drift.txt). The frozen binary's own archive confirms it (anyio-4.15.1.dist-info, LS-4/main-binary-dist-info.txt). sidecar/requirements.txt pins only top-level packages (and google-genai>=1.0, jsonschema>=4.0 float), with no lock or constraints file, so every rebuild can ship a different closure than the one the notices (and CI) saw. No package is missing from the notices and no licence family changed in the drifted set (frozendict LGPL-3.0 still listed in Section A).

title: transform.code size caps are bypassed by sum(list, start): a 25-character expression builds an uncapped list (8.3 GB peak RSS) and keeps running after the 5 s timeout
repro: evaluate_code({}, {'expression': 'sum([[0]*100000]*250, [])'}) -> TimeoutError after 7.98 s with the worker thread still running, peak RSS 8.3 GB; n=80 returns an 8,000,000-item list in 0.6 s. [0]*100001 and 7^(10^7) are refused, so PLATFORM-066's own repros hold; sum's start argument and list + are uncapped. Reachable via save_workflow/run_workflow (MCP, agent) and the server preview.
